title: Keep Practice authorship intact across coaching, claiming and copying
detail: Practice Spark, template claim and edit tools request and return separate coaching questions, with original feature budgets, model tiers and central completion/accounting. Existing-practice build/edit/guided actions perform no content or steer-preference writes; old callers receive zero applied fields. A copied template retains its source text and lineage without applying a chosen model direction. Creation requires the author's own title and reviewed fields; the explicit written-text door carries the author's exact source, never model replacement prose. Claim, composer and Guided surfaces show questions separately; misleading rewrite controls are removed. Manual create, edit, claim and copy remain. Platform operational curation/review templates and optional cover-image tooling are unchanged. Journey generators are a separate packet, not covered by this row. Offline model/server/rendered regressions and bounded source execution pass; no live provider, production mutation, authenticated browser or deployment acceptance is claimed.

verify.note: Actual coercion/planning with inert model and no provider/DB; server mutation boundary checks plus separate focused rendered/server/model suites.
